primitives.name: Run Scoring Mechanism
primitives.verbatim_quote: When he completes this circuit, and crosses the plate without being put out, he scores a run; and the number of runs thus scored in nine innings decides the match.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'R': 'dimensionless run count', 'I': 'dimensionless inning count', 'T': 'time in innings'}
primitives.assumptions: Player completes circuit without interference; game ends after 9 innings.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When player is tagged or forced out before reaching plate.

layer2.mapping: State transition from base to home plate defines scoring kernel in GSE; probabilistic run assignment in GSI.
layer2.telemetry: Run count per inning, player position tracking

primitives.name: Player Out Condition
primitives.verbatim_quote: A batsman is put out if he hits the ball and the ball be caught by an opponent before touching the ground, or if he make three foul bunts.
primitives.assumptions: Catch must occur before ground contact; foul bunts are cumulative.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Three foul bunts or catch before ground touch.

layer2.mapping: Out condition maps to terminal state in GSE; Bayesian update on player elimination in GSI.

primitives.name: Umpire Judgment Role
primitives.verbatim_quote: To provide for the satisfactory conduct of the game, an umpire is agreed upon by the contesting nines, and it is his duty to see that all the provisions of the rules are observed.
primitives.assumptions: Umpire is neutral arbiter; rule enforcement is deterministic.

layer2.mapping: Umpire role defines adjudicative kernel in GSE; probabilistic rule enforcement in GSI.
layer2.telemetry: Rule compliance metrics, dispute resolution logs
